label: Timer Boundary Event
description: A deadline on a task. Fires if the work is not done in time, either cancelling it or raising a reminder alongside it.

timeDuration.label: Duration
timeDuration.description: How long the task may stay open before the event fires, as an ISO 8601 duration such as P5D.

cancelActivity.label: Cancel the task
cancelActivity.description: Whether the event cancels the task it is attached to when it fires, or leaves the task open and starts a parallel branch. Left out, it cancels the task.
